def generate_integers(a, b):
    """
    Given two positive integers a and b, return the even digits between a
    and b.
    """

Clarification: It means the even NUMBERS themselves in the range (i.e. 2,4,6,8 as clamped), not individual digit characters extracted from multi-digit numbers.
